One scene per container Mike is talking about; `cue` = the words he says that bring it on screen (resolved to EDIT-timeline seconds by cue_scenes.py, written back as `t`). `head_until` / `tail_from` bound the Remotion window: the EDIT's own footage plays before/after. A pinned `t` beats a cue. Bullet items with their own cue get `t` too (the active-item highlight).
